import sys

mod = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, n, m=None):
        if m is None:
            m = n
        self.A = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
        self.n = n
        self.m = m

    @staticmethod
    def I(n):
        mat = Matrix(n, n)
        for i in range(n):
            mat.A[i][i] = 1
        return mat

    def height(self):
        return self.n

    def width(self):
        return self.m

    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return self.A[k]

    def __setitem__(self, k, value):
        self.A[k] = value

    def __iadd__(self, B):
        n, m = self.n, self.m
        assert n == B.n and m == B.m
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self.A[i][j] = (self.A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % mod
        return self

    def __isub__(self, B):
        n, m = self.n, self.m
        assert n == B.n and m == B.m
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self.A[i][j] = (self.A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + mod) % mod
        return self

    def __imul__(self, B):
        n = self.n
        m = B.m
        p = self.m
        assert p == B.n
        C = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                for k in range(p):
                    C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + self.A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % mod
        self.A = C
        self.m = m
        return self

    def __pow__(self, k):
        B = Matrix.I(self.n)
        A = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.m):
                A.A[i][j] = self.A[i][j]
        while k > 0:
            if k & 1:
                B *= A
            A *= A
            k >>= 1
        return B

    def __add__(self, B):
        return Matrix(self.n, self.m).__iadd__(self, B)

    def __sub__(self, B):
        return Matrix(self.n, self.m).__isub__(self, B)

    def __mul__(self, B):
        res = Matrix(self.n, B.m)
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(B.m):
                for k in range(self.m):
                    res.A[i][j] = (res.A[i][j] + self.A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % mod
        return res

    def rot(self, K):
        B = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        for i in range(K):
            for j in range(K):
                B.A[i][j] = self.A[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K]
            B.A[i][K] = self.A[(i + K - 1) % K][K]
            B.A[K][i] = self.A[K][(i + K - 1) % K]
        B.A[K][K] = self.A[K][K]
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.m):
                self.A[i][j] = B.A[i][j]

def beki(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    ret = beki(a, b // 2)
    ret = (ret * ret) % mod
    if b & 1:
        ret = (ret * a) % mod
    return ret

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    INDEX = 0
    copy = N
    while copy >= K:
        INDEX += 1
        copy //= K
    
    mat = [[None for _ in range(35)] for __ in range(70)]
    
    mat[0][0] = Matrix.I(K + 1)
    for i in range(1, K + 1):
        mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[0][i] = Matrix(mat[0][i-1].n, mat[0][i-1].m)
        for r in range(mat[0][i-1].n):
            for c in range(mat[0][i-1].m):
                mat[0][i].A[r][c] = mat[0][i-1].A[r][c]
        mat[0][i].rot(K)
    
    for index in range(1, INDEX + 1):
        mat[index][0] = Matrix(mat[index-1][0].n, mat[index-1][0].m)
        for r in range(mat[index-1][0].n):
            for c in range(mat[index-1][0].m):
                mat[index][0].A[r][c] = mat[index-1][0].A[r][c]
        
        for i in range(1, K):
            mat[index][0] = mat[index-1][i] * mat[index][0]
        
        for i in range(1, K):
            mat[index][i] = Matrix(mat[index][i-1].n, mat[index][i-1].m)
            for r in range(mat[index][i-1].n):
                for c in range(mat[index][i-1].m):
                    mat[index][i].A[r][c] = mat[index][i-1].A[r][c]
            mat[index][i].rot(K)
    
    ans = Matrix(K + 1, 1)
    ans.A[K][0] = 1
    
    used = 0
    while INDEX >= 0:
        while beki(K, INDEX) <= N:
            N -= beki(K, INDEX)
            ans = mat[INDEX][used] * ans
            used += 1
            used %= K
        INDEX -= 1
    
    val = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        val += ans.A[i][0]
        val %= mod
    print(val)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
